gates.intentional_fault_acceptance: actual_fault_detected = fault and not (data_ok and vi_ok); only this predicate controls the two intentional fault case statuses, independently of device safety

intentional_fault_exceptions: clock_stopped deliberately changes the clock stimulus
vi_bias_off deliberately disables the VI bias

interpretation: The six varying-data normal cases share active VCE failures at XD61/62/115/116; hot cases additionally fail XD71/72/87/88 active VCE.
Cold cases also exceed 1.6 V in the all-time VCE maxima of XD59/60/111/112; those maxima alone do not locate the violation after startup.
All six varying-data normal cases miss the 30 mV phase gate. Only cold_late passes its VI phase/current gate.
Both constant cases pass device safety and the constant phase gate; constant_one passes the data screen but both constants fail the 2 mV VI output-voltage neutrality gate.
constant_zero also fails comparator x/y margin and clock-to-valid gates; this is a separate failure from VI neutrality.
Intentional clock_stopped and vi_bias_off PASS means failure detection only; all CDR/full-PHY/closed-loop acceptance flags remain false.
limitations: Published JSON extrema are not simultaneous-row causal evidence.
No archive or raw waveform was downloaded or read, no analysis/simulation was rerun, no thresholds changed.
Native simulator elapsed time is absent from the native JSON; recorded job times include setup/publication and are not engine duration.
The summarized data excludes per-bit delay arrays but retains their native full assets and original aggregate verdicts.
